_about: The places on the sea chart (Robin, 2026-11-20: a sea chart of islands; each island a hunting ground with its own levels; he travels by tapping the chart, no ship to steer). A new hero starts in `start`, and wakes there after a fall. Only the place he is in is alive: sailing away empties it, arriving fills it from its zones. A zone keeps `count` monsters of one kind inside its box. `chart` is where the place sits on the chart, as shares of its width and height. Sailing is from a dock only (mine: it gives the walk back its weight). Names are Victor, GD's placeholders (docs/names.md).
